Description
The University of Birmingham has recently opened in in Dubai which allows students to gain a degree from a highly ranked Russell Group university in the UAE. University of Birmingham is 87th in QS World University Rankings 2021, maintaining its position in the top 100 universities globally and placing the University as 13th amongst UK universities.
